_meta.validation_notes: The profile explicitly enumerates 19 top wrong-gender nouns, not forty. Those 19 are first; the remainder of the first forty comes from nouns actually used elsewhere in the same profile. Pattern traps then cover -ode/-ade/-ure, -age, -eau and Greek -ème/-ame families, including salient exceptions.
